scripts.text:
[Belljamin Button]
The monsters here are able to control time.
Come back when you've reached ^0000FFLevel 150^000000.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔贾明·巴顿]
这里的魔物能够操控时间。
请等到您达到^0000FF150级^000000再来。

scripts.text:
[Belljamin Button]
The monsters here are able to control time.
Time, memories, environments... all can become warped here.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔贾明·巴顿]
这里的魔物能够操控时间。
时间、记忆、环境...在这里都可能发生扭曲。

scripts.text:
[Belljamin Button]
I'm begging you not to ask more about it. It might put your life in danger.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔贾明·巴顿]
我求您不要再多问了。这可能会危及您的生命。

scripts.text: Don't ask
scripts.translation: 不再多问

scripts.text: Go to 2nd floor of warped tower
scripts.translation: 前往扭曲塔二层

scripts.text: Go to 3rd floor of warped tower
scripts.translation: 前往扭曲塔三层

scripts.text:
[Belljamin Button]
Be careful with your choice.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔贾明·巴顿]
请谨慎做出选择。

scripts.text:
[Belljamin Button]
I need ^0000FF10,000z^000000 to let you in. It's a pretty dangerous place to be.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔贾明·巴顿]
我需要^0000FF10,000z^000000才能让您进去。那里非常危险。

scripts.text: Quit
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text: Pay 10,000z
Why do you need money?
scripts.translation: 为什么需要钱？

scripts.text:
[Belljamin Button]
Really? You don't have the money and asked me to take you there?
scripts.translation:
[贝尔贾明·巴顿]
真的吗？您没有钱却还让我带您去那里？

scripts.text:
[Belljamin Button]
I'm not sure how you'll keep track of time in there but be as careful as you can.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔贾明·巴顿]
我不确定您在那里如何把握时间，但请务必小心。

scripts.text:
[Belljamin Button]
I am here all day for the safety of adventurers. I always alert them about the danger. That's why I need some form of payment.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔贾明·巴顿]
我全天都在这里保障冒险者的安全。我总是提醒他们危险的存在。所以我需要一些报酬。

scripts.text:
[Belljamin Button]
Phew...You've made a good choice. This place is brutal so you should probably get back to a safe area.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔贾明·巴顿]
呼...您做出了正确的选择。这里非常残酷，您最好回到安全区域。

scripts.text:
[Belljamin Button]
Perhaps you've seen me before?
scripts.translation:
[贝尔贾明·巴顿]
也许您以前见过我？

scripts.text:
[Belljamin Button]
You saw me in a different place, with a different look.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔贾明·巴顿]
您在不同的地方见过我，那时的我看起来不一样。

scripts.text: Who are you?
scripts.translation: 你是谁？

scripts.text: Get me out of here!
scripts.translation: 带我离开这里！

scripts.text:
[Belljamin Button]
Can you explain to me what you've seen, what you've done?
scripts.translation:
[贝尔贾明·巴顿]
您能告诉我您看到了什么，做了什么吗？

scripts.text:
[Belljamin Button]
Me too. You might also be a missing one. Unaware, with no purpose nor idea.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔贾明·巴顿]
我也是。您可能也是迷失者之一。茫然无知，没有目的，也没有想法。

scripts.text:
[Belljamin Button]
It's time to go back. Please cherish your time some more.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔贾明·巴顿]
是时候回去了。请更加珍惜您的时间。

scripts.text: Stay a little bit more
scripts.translation: 再多待一会儿

scripts.text: Please take me back
scripts.translation: 请带我回去

scripts.text:
[Belljamin Button]
You must really like this place. Well, do whatever you want.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔贾明·巴顿]
看来您真的很喜欢这里。好吧，随您便。

scripts.text:
[Belljamin Button]
It's time to move on. Do you have a favorite drink?
scripts.translation:
[贝尔贾明·巴顿]
是时候该前进了。您有喜欢的饮品吗？

scripts.text:
[Belljamin Button]
Think about the drink in a cup. Slowly stir the cup with a spoon and peer through as the drink changes color.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔贾明·巴顿]
想象一下杯中的饮品。用勺子慢慢搅拌，透过杯子观察饮品颜色的变化。
